title: Micro-retro + commitments + action backlog
content:
Context / why this doc exists:
- Quick personal micro-retro for the quarter to feed into a short self-review and prep for 1:1 with manager. Not polished — scratchpad for evidence, asks, and micro-commitments I can actually keep.

Structure (use in 15-20 minutes):
1) 3 wins (evidence bullets)
2) 2 things that went sideways + root cause hypothesis
3) 3 micro commitments (2-week cadence)
4) Quick asks for manager / career signals
5) Action backlog (triaged by priority)
6) Habit tracker + measurement idea

1) Three wins (concise evidence I can paste into review):
- Reduced new-hire onboarding churn: revamped the first-week checklist, consolidated access links, and got NDAs + infra access time down from avg 6.8 days -> 2.9 days (tracked via onboarding spreadsheet). Anecdote: hired engineer X said they felt productive on day 4.
- Ran two cross-functional calibration sessions for performance conversations; created a one-page rubric that teams adopted. Result: 80% of managers reported rubric was useful (survey n=15, quick pulse).
- Launched pilot of peer recognition badges (small automation): 42 recognitions in 4 weeks, positive sentiment in Slack thread and one group asked for team-level leaderboard.

2) Two things that went sideways + hypothesis:
- Offboarding automation failure: last-minute access revocation missed a contractor because of a naming mismatch in the HR export -> hypothesis: HR export schema changed; we need schema validation step + alert.
- Coaching cadence drift: promised monthly manager coaching sessions but fell to bi-monthly during sprint crunch -> hypothesis: overloaded calendar + no recurring short meeting marker. Solution: protect a 30-min biweekly slot and add task reminders.

3) Three micro-commitments (2-week cycles) — measurable and bite-sized:
- Commitment A: Implement schema validation for HR export and add a failing alert in the offboarding runbook. Success metric: zero missed revocations in next 60 days; test on 5 sample exports.
- Commitment B: Reintroduce a protected 30-min biweekly calendar block ("People Ops coaching"), block for next 3 months. Success: at least 4 sessions held in 8 weeks.
- Commitment C: Convert the one-page calibration rubric into a SharePoint/Confluence template and a 10-min manager walkthrough video. Success: template used by 3 teams in next quarter.

4) Quick asks for manager (prep for 1:1):
- FYI: pilot went well; ask for permission to expand peer recognition to org-level (need $200/month budget for recognitions platform).
- Ask: 1 promotion calibration question — want feedback on whether the rubric and evidence for Lina qualify (I have 3 specific impact bullets).
- Career signal: looking for stretch project that touches onboarding automation + infra — want manager to flag opportunities and introduce to infra lead.

5) Action backlog (triaged):
- P0: Offboarding schema validation + alert (blocked by time; need 2-3 dev hours).
- P1: Block out coaching slots; schedule first two sessions (can do myself).
- P1: Budget proposal for recognition platform (draft and send to finance).
- P2: Create calibration template + walkthrough video (can be async).
- P3: Measurement plan for onboarding time (design metrics + dashboard request to analytics).

Quick notes on prioritization: P0 must be done before next contractor offboarding cycle; P1 & P2 can run in parallel; P3 depends on analytics bandwidth — start with a simple spreadsheet if needed.

6) Habit tracker + measurement idea (two-week check):
- Week 1: run a test of schema validation on 3 exports, block two coaching slots, draft budget email.
- Week 2: fix any schema gaps, hold at least one coaching session, finish budget draft and send.
- Measurement: weekly checklist with three checkboxes; maintain in a private recurring Google Sheet and snapshot on Friday.

Notes to self / shorthand (quick copy-paste lines for review sections):
- "Led onboarding checklist overhaul — reduced avg access time from 6.8d to 2.9d, improved first-week ramp; references: onboarding-spreadsheet row 78-91."
- "Created calibration rubric adopted by 4 teams; managers report improved alignment (pulse survey)."
- "Pilot recognition automation shipped; positive engagement signal (42 uses / 4 weeks)."
- Ask: "Can we expand recognition pilot org-wide? Need $200/mo."

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Who on infra can spare 3 hours for offboarding schema validation? Tag candidate: Jonah K.
- Do we have a canonical place to host the calibration template? If no, create Confluence page.
- Should recognition platform be charged to People Ops or Growth? Check with finance.

Random scratch ideas (brainstorm — keep informal):
- Tiny automation: add a Slack bot that reminds managers to give one recognition per month to new hires.
- Micro-A/B: test two versions of first-week email (link style vs. inlined steps) and measure click/time-to-first-PR.

Quick retro summary (one-liner to paste into self-review):
- "This quarter I improved joiner ramp and manager alignment by shipping onboarding checklist improvements, a calibration rubric, and a lightweight recognition pilot; next quarter focus is automation reliability and scaling the pilot."

Logistics (where this lives):
- Mirror this to personal confluence at Confluence:Personal/Aisha/Micro-retro and paste evidence into formal self-review doc by Mar 20.

End of scratchpad.

-- A.P. (quick timestamp: 2026-03-10)
